packageRules.description: One runner image serves clusters on different Kubernetes versions, and kubectl supports a difference of one minor version to the cluster, so patch updates get their own PR
prBodyNotes: kubectl is shared by all clusters that use this image and supports a difference of one minor version to the API server. Merge a new minor version only when every cluster runs that minor version, one lower or one higher (`kubernetes_version` in `group_vars/all.yml` of the infrastructure repo).

packageRules.description: Helm 4 is not yet supported, same as helm_version in the infrastructure repo
